Are you a UBC student or alumni? 

NOTE: Only UBC students & Alumni/Staff are allowed to table at this market

NOTE: Any misrepresentation regarding UBC student/alumni status will result in being banned from participating in all future events.
column8: Please provide your UBC/alumni/staff email address as proof of affiliation. If you do not have an email address, please see the next question.
column9: If you do not have an UBC email, please attach proof of UBC affiliation (e.g. Workday timetable for this term, alumni card, grad certificate, etc.)
column10:

This will be the main form of communication with our team and volunteers during the event itself. Please provide your discord even if you are already in the server - this is how we will give you permission to the vendor-only channels.

Join our Discord here!

column16:
Please provide a link to your portfolio or any samples of your work that you will be selling at UBC Makers Market! (e.g. Google Drive, website, Instagram)

For Google Drive, please add at least 3 examples of your work and ensure that drive links are viewable or else your application will not be considered.
column17:
I certify that the work I will be selling is my own original work, and not AI generated, drop-shipped, or stolen. If you are using a pattern created by someone else, please provide a link with proof in the additional comments that shows you have received explicit permission to use the pattern for commercial purposes.

If found to be false, your application will be withdrawn and rejected. A ban from all future events will be issued.

(Note: 3rd party manufacturing is permitted as long as it is still your original design/artwork)
column18:
I certify that the work I will be selling abides by the most recent Health Canada guidelines. It is the seller's responsibility to ensure their products remain up to date and in full compliance with all applicable regulations.

I understand that if I do not abide by these guidelines then I risk being rejected and/or removed from the event.

Useful Links:  
(consumer products) https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/consumer-product-safety/reports-publications/industry-professionals/canada-consumer-product-safety-act-guide.html

column27:
Do you want to have a half table or full table?

NOTE:
- Half tables will cost 50% of the price of a full table.
- You may have to share a table with a stranger.
- Full tables have less availability; choosing "Either" increases your chances of being selected if spots become limited.
column28:
If you chose half table, do you have anyone you would like to share a full table with?

Please enter the exact email address they submitted on their application here.

NOTE:
- They must submit their own separate application.
- We will do our best to put you together, but we do not guarantee that you will share a table.
- The email entered must match our records. Please confirm with your desired table mate.
- You must be attending on the same days in the same table tiers in order to share a table.
